hypotheses.V0_discovery_basis_is_frozen: The value basis is fit only on fold 0/split 0 and evaluated without refitting on the other five cells.
hypotheses.V1_rank4_is_a_literal_value_echo: Rank 4 captures at least 50% of raw post-boundary H2 value-delta energy in every held-out cell.
hypotheses.V2_rank4_is_causally_sufficient: Rank 4 recovers at least 70% of the finite value-dependent H2 edge effect in every held-out cell.
hypotheses.V3_rank4_beats_random_subspaces: Rank 4 exceeds the best of eight frozen random rank-4 subspaces by at least 0.20 causal fidelity in every held-out cell.
hypotheses.V4_rank1_is_nearly_sufficient: Rank 1 reaches at least 80% of rank-16 causal fidelity in at least four of five held-out cells.
hypotheses.V5_routing_alone_is_incomplete: Routing-only finite effect is below 50% of the complete H2 post-boundary effect in every held-out cell.
